description: One deterministic, provider-neutral production task packet (CF-WO-P1-004, Task J). Compiled by the task compiler from a validated production bundle. The canonical instruction is provider-neutral; any provider-specific translation lives separately in provider_translation and never replaces the canonical intent. A packet never claims execution: provider_status is not-executed until an adapter records a real result, and when no verified provider exists the packet is a complete provider-neutral handoff. This schema carries no timestamps, so packet_hash is deterministic: the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the packet without the packet_hash field itself.

authorization_required.description: The authorization this task needs before an adapter may act on it.

action.description: The authorization action (for example transmit_to_provider, use_in_production, export_private_asset).

required.description: Whether authorization is required for this task.

canonical_instruction.description: The canonical, provider-neutral instruction for this task. Written once, in Brain terms; provider adapters translate it, they never rewrite it.

expected_output.description: What a completed task must produce, and how to tell it is right.

acceptance_checks.description: Deterministic or human-review checks that decide whether the output is accepted (for example file exists, resolution matches, dialogue byte-identical, no face drift vs approved reference).

format.description: Expected output format (for example png, mp4, wav, json).

job_id.description: The production job this packet belongs to.

packet_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this packet without the packet_hash field itself. A packet whose recomputed hash differs was tampered with.

project_id.description: The project this packet belongs to.

provenance.description: Where this task came from. Tasks are never presented as user instructions when they were inferred.

note.description: One line saying why this provenance label applies.

provider_capability_requirements.description: Capabilities a provider must actually have for this task (matched against the provider capability registry, never assumed).

capability.description: The required capability (for example generate-speech, reference-image, character-reference, native-camera-controls).

required.description: Whether this capability is required (true) or preferred (false).

provider_status.description: not-executed: compiled, no adapter has acted. handed-off: given to an adapter or to the user as a provider-neutral handoff. unavailable-no-verified-provider: no verified provider exists; the packet is a handoff only. This field is set by the compiler; execution results are recorded on the job, never by editing a compiled packet.

provider_translation.description: Provider-specific translation of the canonical instruction, where a verified adapter for the matched provider exists. Separate from canonical intent; absent when there is no verified adapter.

provider_id.description: The provider this translation is for.

translated_instruction.description: The instruction translated for this provider's interface.

qc_conditions.description: QC conditions that apply to this task's output (for example Critical: face must match approved reference; Major: lip-sync must match dialogue).

required_inputs.description: Inputs this task needs, with approved asset references. A task that needs an approved reference must name it; a missing required input is a compile error, never a silent skip.

input_ref.description: The input reference (asset id, plan id, profile id, or script id).

kind.description: What kind of input this is.

required.description: Whether the task can run without this input.

restrictions.description: Restrictions on this task (for example never redesign the approved face; dialogue verbatim; no commercial voice route).

scene_id.description: The scene this task belongs to, when it is scene-scoped.

shot_id.description: The shot this task belongs to, when it is shot-scoped.

task_id.description: Stable task id within the job (for example t-voice-s01-l03).

task_type.description: What kind of production work this packet is. media-technical is technical media work a provider can evidence (probe, validate, assemble, transcode). creative-editing is picture editing, creative colour review and narrative pacing review — human creative work no provider in the registry evidences. semantic-qc-review is human semantic QC (character continuity, physical realism, semantic visual/audio review). editing-finishing and qc-review are kept for already-compiled packages; the compiler no longer emits them (see B4).

beat_id.description: The story beat this task belongs to, when it is beat-scoped.

cue_timing.description: Structured cue timing for sound tasks (and any task that carries a timed cue). timing_status is planned for every compiled packet: a plan never claims an audio file was already generated. Actual rendered-clip timing is recorded in execution results, never in a compiled packet.

cue_id.description: Stable cue id from the production analysis.

distance.description: Apparent distance of the sound source.

duration_seconds.description: Cue duration in seconds, when known.

end_anchor.description: What the cue's end is anchored to, when it has one.

mixing_priority.description: Mixing priority for this cue (for example dialogue-first, foreground, background).

start_anchor.description: What the cue's start is anchored to.

start_offset_seconds.description: Seconds after the start anchor at which the cue starts, when known.

sync_target.description: What this cue must synchronise with.

timing_status.description: planned: timing from the production plan. actual-rendered: timing measured from a real rendered clip (execution results only).

identity_bindings.description: Structured identity bindings for this task (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task F/G): one entry per visible registered character in the shot, each naming the exact approved reference assets for that character. Text saying 'maintain character consistency' is never a substitute. A provider that cannot support the required references is not matched to an identity-critical task.

angle_matched_reference.description: Angle-matched reference for this shot (front / three-quarter / profile, chosen from the shot framing).

character_ref.description: How the script refers to this character.

fixed_identity_reference.description: Reference to the fixed identity instruction (prompt-block digest or fixed_identity record hash).

primary_reference_id.description: Asset id of the primary (front-facing) identity reference.

reference_asset_ids.description: Approved reference asset ids for this character.

reference_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the primary identity reference, where available.

wardrobe_variation.description: Approved wardrobe / scene variation for this shot.

voice_binding.description: Exact voice-profile binding for a speaking dialogue-line task (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task J): the selected approved voice profile for exactly this character, with its authorized reference-audio asset. The raw voice audio stays in authorized private storage; only the asset id and hash travel in the packet.

ownership_consent_ref.description: Reference to the voice ownership/consent evidence (profile id + approval record).

title: Task Packet
